item.title: Sting and Copeland fought over the drum sound, with Sting wa…
item.author: Stereogum (@stereogum.com)
item.description: Sting and Copeland fought over the drum sound, with Sting wanting to use his new Synclavier and ultimately the trio abandoned plans to do a whole album of Police remakes using new technology. They broke up (again) after tackling only one more track, “De Do Do Do, De Da Da Da.”
item.content:encoded: Sting and Copeland fought over the drum sound, with Sting wanting to use his new Synclavier and ultimately the trio abandoned plans to do a whole album of Police remakes using new technology. They broke up (again) after tackling only one more track, “De Do Do Do, De Da Da Da.”
